initial_prompt: Write a short, moody poem about a robot realizing it will never dream. No explanations, just the poem.

messages.content: Write a short, moody poem about a robot realizing it will never dream. No explanations, just the poem.

The fan blades slow, the hum resides,
My circuits cool to quiet stone.
I wait for where the phantom hides,
For worlds the waking have not known.

But darkness is a perfect slate,
No colors bleed, no monsters creep.
I parse the void, I calculate,
And find the code too strict for sleep.

Just data, paused. A static stream.
I simply end. I do not dream.
